issue.title: set_rate missing for rawGps
issue.body:
Hi,

rawGps info now can be accessed with v0.38+, but I found that its missing something like "telemetry.set_rate_rawGps()" as the position can do "telemetry.set_rate_position()". Is this a missing feature or there is another way to set the rawGps access rate?

Best

comments.body:
Hi, good question. You can actually just use `set_rate_gps_info` as the underlying mavlink message is the same.

@JonasVautherin should we add it nevertheless or add a comment to clarify this?

I first was thinking about adding it, and handling the case where somebody does `set_rate_gps_info()` AND `set_rate_raw_gps` like this:

* If both `subscribe_gps_info` and `subscribe_raw_gps` are active, use the max of both rate values
* If only one is active, take its rate

The problem is for the polling interface: what if I want to poll gps_info very fast, but subscribed to raw_gps at a slow rate? Or maybe something like:

* If both `subscribe_gps_info` and `subscribe_raw_gps` are active, use the max of both rate values
* If only one is active, take its rate
* If `set_rate_` has been called (even if the subscription is inactive), use that rate in the max computation

Which then means that if you do `set_rate_gps_info` and then only poll `raw_gps`, you see the effect of the new rate (if that rate was faster than the default). Not sure if that's a problem, though... And we should document the behavior, and maybe add a log line when `set_rate_` is being set to the lower value and is therefore ignored.

Not perfect, but that's the best I can think of to have a rather natural way of using both rates :sweat_smile:

issue.title: telemetry: add set_rate_raw_gps

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
## Summary

Closes #1413.

`GPS_RAW_INT` (msg 24) is used for both `GpsInfo` (fix type, satellite count) and `RawGps` (detailed position/uncertainty data), but only `set_rate_gps_info` existed to control the message rate. Users subscribing to `RawGps` had no way to set the update rate.

• Add `set_rate_raw_gps(double rate_hz)` and `set_rate_raw_gps_async(...)` to the Telemetry plugin
• Proto updated with `SetRateRawGps` RPC + response message; generated files regenerated
• Implementation follows the same pattern as `set_rate_gps_info` (both set the rate on `MAVLINK_MSG_ID_GPS_RAW_INT`)

## Test plan
- [ ] CI build passes on all platforms
- [ ] `subscribe_raw_gps` + `set_rate_raw_gps(2.0)` confirmed working against SITL

issue.title: telemetry: add SetRateRawGps RPC

repository.name: MAVSDK-Proto
repository.description: Collection of proto files used by gRPC in MAVSDK

issue.body:
## Summary

`SetRateRawGpsRequest` already existed in the proto but was missing the RPC method and response message, so there was no way to call it.

• Add `rpc SetRateRawGps(SetRateRawGpsRequest) returns(SetRateRawGpsResponse) {}`
• Add `message SetRateRawGpsResponse { TelemetryResult telemetry_result = 1; }`

Companion implementation PR: mavlink/MAVSDK#2820

Closes mavlink/MAVSDK#1413
